data.title: Phaos Technology Explores AI-Enabled Automated Car Wash Opportunity in Southeast Asia
data.description:
SINGAPORE, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Limited (NYSE American: POAS) ("Phaos" or the "Company") today outlined an opportunity to develop automated car wash and vehicle care services in Southeast Asia, particularly in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand. The Company is evaluating Singapore and Malaysia as initial markets for services that combine convenience for drivers and fleet operators with automation and water reuse. In a second phase, it may consider expanding into other Southeast Asian markets.

Singapore had more than 650,000 cars in October 2026, including nearly 99,000 private-hire cars, according to Land Transport Authority data1. In Malaysia, the Malaysian Automotive Association2 reported 630,461 new passenger vehicles sold from January through October 2026, up about 4% year over year. Separately, Grand View Research3 estimates that Malaysia's broader car wash services market could grow from US$208.9 million in 2025 to US$361.7 million by 2033, a projected annual growth rate of 7.3% from 2026 to 2033. The forecast covers multiple wash formats and does not estimate revenue for Phaos.

In Indonesia, Ken Research4 estimates that paid professional car wash services could grow from US$390 million in 2025 to US$686 million in 2032, or 8.4% annually. In Thailand, a nationwide National Statistical Office survey5 put 2023 receipts for businesses classified under car washing, polishing and similar services at THB 14.1 billion. In October 2026, Bangchak6 reported Lodon JetX automated washes at 50 of its fuel stations, showing adoption of the format. The two market figures cover broader service categories and do not measure Phaos's addressable revenue.

Phaos is exploring the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to automate car washing, with the aim of reducing labor costs and improving water recycling. In Singapore, Inchcape reported that the automated gantry it developed with Kärcher can recycle up to 85% of the water used per wash.7

"We see an opportunity to serve vehicles that need regular care," said Gan Hong Loon, Chief Executive Officer of Phaos. "Singapore and specific regions in Malaysia give us places to test demand and site economics before we consider expanding."

About Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Limited

Headquartered in Singapore, Phaos has its roots in advanced microscopy and is pursuing a strategic repositioning toward engineering, procurement and construction (EPC). For more information, visit the company website.8

Forward-Looking Statements

This release contains forward-looking statements under applicable U.S. securities laws, including the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, where applicable. These statements concern potential services and sites and possible expansion. Actual outcomes may differ materially due to financing, required approvals, site economics, customer adoption and other risks described in the Company's Annual Report on Form 20-F, as amended, and subsequent filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. These statements speak only as of this release date. Phaos undertakes no duty to update them except as required by law.

No Offer or Solicitation

This release is for information only. It does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to purchase any securities.

data.title: IP Strategy Receives Nasdaq Notification Regarding Delayed Form 10-Q Filing
data.description:
GIG HARBOR, WA / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq:IPST) (the "Company" or "IP Strategy") today announced that it received a notification letter from The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq") dated November 24, 2026, advising the Company that, because it has not yet filed its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2026 (the "Form 10-Q"), the Company is not currently in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1).

Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) requires listed companies to timely file all required periodic financial reports with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The Nasdaq notification has no immediate effect on the listing of the Company's common stock on Nasdaq. However, if the Company fails to timely regain compliance with the Listing Rule 5250(c)(1), the Company's common stock will be subject to delisting from Nasdaq.

Under the Nasdaq Listing Rules, the Company has 60 calendar days from the date of the notification, or until January 23, 2027, to submit to Nasdaq a plan to regain compliance. If Nasdaq accepts the Company's plan, Nasdaq may grant the Company an exception of up to 180 calendar days from the original due date of the Form 10-Q, or until May 24, 2027, to regain compliance. If Nasdaq does not accept the Company's plan, then the Company will have the opportunity to appeal that decision to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel.

The Company is diligently working to complete and file the Form 10-Q and intends to take the necessary steps to regain compliance with Nasdaq's continued listing requirements in December 2026.

About IP Strategy

IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: IPST) is the first Nasdaq-listed company to hold $DATA tokens, formerly $IP, as a primary treasury reserve asset and operate validator infrastructure for the DATA Network. The Company provides public market investors broad exposure to the AI-native data economy through a regulated equity vehicle. IP Strategy's treasury reserve enables direct participation in the DATA ecosystem, which supports the sourcing, verification, provenance and auditability of real-world data while enabling trusted attribution and commercialization of digital assets and AI training data.

This press release contains forward-looking statements, including statements regarding the Company's ability and timing to complete and file its Form 10-Q and regain compliance with Nasdaq's continued listing requirements. These risks and uncertainties include those described in the Company's filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission. data.title: Aptera Motors Corp. Announces 2026 Annual Meeting
data.description:
CARLSBAD, Calif., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aptera Motors Corp. (Nasdaq: SEV) (the “Company”), today announced that its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the “Annual Meeting”) will be held on Wednesday, December 9, 2026. The Annual Meeting will be conducted in two parts: a business session for holders of record of Class A common stock beginning at 1:00 p.m. Pacific Time, held in person at 5818 El Camino Real, Carlsbad, CA 92008, followed by a general session beginning at approximately 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time, held online at https://aptera.us/2026-annual-meeting.

Class A Common Stock (Voting Class). Holders of record of Class A common stock as of the close of business on November 20, 2026 are entitled to one vote per share and may vote only in person at the business session by written ballot. No proxies will be accepted. Attendance at the business session is limited to such Class A holders of record. The business session will be held in person only at 5818 El Camino Real, Carlsbad, CA 92008, and no remote access to the business session will be available.

Class B Common Stock (Non-Voting Class). Holders of Class B common stock have no voting rights at the Annual Meeting. Class B holders may attend the general session online, beginning at approximately 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time, in a non-voting capacity and may submit questions in advance as described below. No action by Class B stockholders is required, and the Company is not soliciting proxies in connection with the Annual Meeting.

How to Attend the General Session. The general session will be held online at https://aptera.us/2026-annual-meeting beginning at approximately 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time on December 9, 2026.

Submitting Questions. Stockholders, including holders of Class A and Class B common stock, may submit questions in advance, no later than 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time on December 4, 2026, by email to ir@aptera.us. No questions will be taken live during the Annual Meeting. During the general session, management will respond to submitted questions that are pertinent to Company matters and appropriate under the rules of conduct, as time permits, and similar questions may be grouped.

About Aptera Motors Corp.

Aptera Motors Corp. (Nasdaq: SEV) is a solar mobility company driven by a mission to advance the future of efficient transportation. Its flagship vehicle is conceived to be a paradigm-shifting solar electric vehicle that leverages breakthroughs in aerodynamics, material science and solar technology to pursue new levels of efficiency. As a public benefit corporation, Aptera is committed to building a sustainable business that positively impacts its stakeholders and the environment. Aptera is headquartered in Carlsbad, California. For more information, please visit www.aptera.us.

data.title: Maison Solutions Inc. Announces Receipt of Nasdaq Notice Regarding Audit Committee Composition Requirements
data.description:
MONTEREY PARK, CA / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / Maison Solutions Inc. (Nasdaq:MSS) (the "Company"), a U.S. specialty grocery retailer focused on Asian food and merchandise, announced that on November 24, 2026 it received a notice of deficiency (the "Notice") from the Nasdaq Stock Market ("Nasdaq").

The non-compliance cited by Nasdaq in the Notice is the result of the previously announced departure of Mr. Bin Wang from his position on the Audit Committee of the Company's Board of Directors. With the departure of Mr. Wang, the Company is currently not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605(c)(2)(A) requiring three independent members on its Audit Committee.

As disclosed in the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed on November 23, 2026, the Company notified Nasdaq of the deficiency on November 19, 2026. Mr. Wang's resignation from the Company's Board of Directors and Audit Committee became effective on November 20, 2026, leaving two members on the Audit Committee.

The Notice indicated that, consistent with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605(c)(4), Nasdaq will provide the Company a cure period (i) until the earlier of the Company's next annual shareholders' meeting or November 20, 2027, or (ii) if the next annual meeting is held before May 19, 2027, then until no later than May 19, 2027, in order to regain compliance (the "Cure Period").

The Company is actively searching for an additional independent director for its Audit Committee and expects to fill the current vacancy and appoint a third independent director to the Audit Committee of the Company's Board of Directors as soon as practicable and within the Cure Period.

About Maison Solutions Inc.

Maison Solutions Inc. is a U.S. specialty grocery retailer focused on Asian food and merchandise. The Company is committed to providing Asian fresh produce, meat, seafood and other daily necessities in a manner that caters to traditional Asian American family values and cultural norms, while also accounting for the faster-paced lifestyle of younger generations and the diverse makeup of the communities in which the Company operates. The Company's grocery retail operations are located in Southern California and Arizona under the HK Good Fortune and Lee Lee International brands.

For more information about Maison Solutions, please visit www.maisonsolutionsinc.com. Follow the Company on LinkedIn and X.

data.title: Kennedy's Own Words Raise Questions About DOJ's Marijuana Rescheduling Order
data.description:
WASHINGTON, D.C. / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / Four months before the Department of Justice moved state-licensed marijuana to Schedule III, the nation's top health official stood in the Oval Office and admitted that federal regulators lacked standardized dosing, lacked scientific studies, and could not even distinguish botanicals from synthetics.

On December 18, 2025, President Donald Trump signed an executive order directing the Justice Department to complete the rescheduling of marijuana. Standing beside him was Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.-the cabinet official statutorily responsible for the scientific and medical evaluation of every controlled substance in the United States.

According to the official transcript published by the U.S. Government Publishing Office in the Daily Compilation of Presidential Documents (DCPD-202501205), Secretary Kennedy did not describe a settled body of clinical evidence. He described the exact opposite:

  • "The evidence on all of these is anecdotal and it's hypothetical because we have not been able to do scientific studies," Secretary Kennedy stated.
  • "There is no standardized dosing, and if you don't have standardized dosing, any study that you do is comparing apples to pears."
  • "We don't know the difference between botanicals and synthetics."

Secretary Kennedy further described rescheduling as "a scientific question, that has divided our country for many, many years," and acknowledged "valid claims about the negative impacts, about addiction, about psychosis." His stated rationale for signing the order was not that the science had been proven, but that rescheduling would supposedly allow researchers to begin looking for answers: "This will finally allow us to study this issue and to answer these questions for the American people."

Lobbying Access vs. Statutory Scientific Standards

The Oval Office transcript also documents who brought the initiative to the White House. "My friend Howard Kessler, without whom we wouldn't be here today, has drove this-this change in the schedule," Secretary Kennedy told the room, stating that Kessler acted out of his personal experience during cancer treatment and adding, "He has nothing to gain from this."

President Trump described Kessler as a friend who visited him "on more than one occasion" and noted that "that's what he asked me to do." Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Administrator Mehmet Oz called Kessler "an early caller of the President" while unveiling a new CMS innovation model giving Medicare beneficiaries access to retail CBD/hemp products-a program Kessler's organization, The Commonwealth Project, later publicly credited as a vision it had "helped champion."

Under the federal Controlled Substances Act (CSA), however, drug scheduling is not governed by personal anecdotes or White House access. Federal law requires an objective scientific and medical evaluation across eight statutory factors, a validated drug product with reproducible dosing, and-under binding D.C. Circuit precedent-a formal on-the-record administrative hearing where scientific evidence is tested under oath.

What Happened Next: Skipping the Hearing and Bypassing FDA Clinical Trials

Four months later, on April 22, 2026, the Attorney General issued AG Order No. 6754-2026 transferring state-licensed marijuana to Schedule III. The order did not wait for the controlled clinical studies Secretary Kennedy said were necessary. It terminated the formal administrative hearing before evidence could be cross-examined. And it treated state-level commercial licenses as proof of "currently accepted medical use" for retail cannabis and hemp products whose dosing the HHS Secretary had explicitly admitted was not standardized.

MMJ International Holdings, Inc. (MMJIH), alongside a coalition including the States of Nebraska and Indiana and Smart Approaches to Marijuana (SAM), is challenging AG Order No. 6754-2026 in the U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit (SAM Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice, No. 26-1106, consolidated with Nos. 26-1130 and 26-1136).

"Secretary Kennedy named the exact scientific standard federal law requires-and proved why the April 22 rescheduling order violates it," said Duane Boise, President and CEO of MMJ International Holdings. "No standardized dosing. Anecdotal evidence. Unanswered questions on safety, psychosis, and addiction. Those are not excuses to bypass an Administrative Procedure Act hearing or waive FDA drug-approval rules; they are the exact reasons Congress mandated standardized final dose forms and controlled clinical trials."

"Standardized pharmaceutical dosing is not a mystery, and not a single state marijuana operator or retail hemp company in CMS's Medicare program has achieved it," Boise continued. "MMJ has spent more than eight years and over $10 million doing the real scientific work inside the federal FDA and DEA framework-developing a validated, GMP pharmaceutical final dose form of 50,000 soft-gel capsules with exact, reproducible amounts of THC and CBD, built specifically for FDA-regulated clinical trials to prove safety and efficacy in Huntington's disease and multiple sclerosis. Secretary Kennedy said rescheduling would allow the country to answer these scientific questions. Instead, the Justice Department declared them answered without a single FDA clinical trial."

Primary Source Documentation

The official transcript, "Remarks on Signing an Executive Order on Increasing Medical Marijuana and Cannabidiol Research and an Exchange With Reporters" (December 18, 2025), is publicly archived by the U.S. Government Publishing Office at govinfo.gov under Document ID DCPD-202501205.

About MMJ International Holdings, Inc.

MMJ International Holdings, Inc. (MMJIH) is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical cannabinoid drug development company pursuing FDA marketing approval exclusively through traditional federal FDA and DEA pathways. Through its wholly owned subsidiaries, MMJ BioPharma Cultivation, Inc. and MMJ BioPharma Labs, Inc., MMJ holds two FDA-accepted Investigational New Drug (IND) applications for proprietary cannabinoid formulations targeting Huntington's disease and multiple sclerosis, an FDA Orphan Drug Designation for Huntington's disease, and a DEA Schedule I analytical laboratory registration. MMJ has manufactured a standardized, reproducible GMP pharmaceutical final dose form-THC/CBD soft-gel capsules-designed for controlled FDA clinical trials to prove safety and efficacy.

data.title: ICE Review: Canola Stronger Friday
data.description:
WINNIPEG, Manitoba--Intercontinental Exchange canola futures were stronger on Friday, benefiting from spillover in sharp increases in Chicago soybeans and soyoil.

Additional spillover came from gains in Chicago soymeal, Malaysian palm oil and European rapeseed. Losses in crude oil limited the upside in canola and other veg oils.

The January canola contract remained slightly above its 20- and 200-day moving averages but remained well short of its other technical levels.

The Canadian Grain Commission reported for the week ended Nov. 22 that year-to-date canola exports climbed to 2.86 million tonnes this marketing year, compared to 1.93 million the same time last year. Cumulative domestic use of canola hit 4.01 million tonnes versus 3.69 million a year ago.

The Canadian dollar dipped lower on Friday afternoon, with the loonie at 70.17 U.S. cents, compared to Thursday's close of 70.21.

There were 69,512 canola contracts traded on Friday, compared to 24,722 on Thursday. Spreading accounted for 44,428 contracts traded.
